checks.eventScope: CUDA start before launch; stop after launch; stop synchronized before elapsed-time query. Device fragment loads, C initialization, loop, and output stores are inside. Host packing, D2H copies, and full CPU output checks are outside.

pendingNativeGates: Exact 3*Chains dense or Chains dense plus Chains sparse MMA instructions inside the executed round-loop backedge.
All counted MMA instructions unpredicated; no hoisting or elimination; exactly 1024 iterations at the benchmark launch.
Each four-register C group feeds the next operation and its next-round counterpart, with separate chains and all final outputs stored.
Scalarized C arrays; zero compiler spill/local/shared usage; record actual registers and API occupancy prediction.
limits: Source semantics do not by themselves establish emitted instruction counts or scalarization; no GPU admission is implied before the native-code gate.
Every launch is separated by a complete CPU output check and D2H readback. Timing therefore measures per-launch rates under this cadence, not uninterrupted sustained device capacity.
Dense/hybrid repetitions are paired within each chain-count panel. Four- versus eight-chain panels execute at different times and are not interleaved controls for clock or thermal drift.
MMA feedback sums integer-convolution matrices. Raw-core equivalents count executions of the validated arithmetic sequence, not independently materialized raw128 products on every round.
Host preparation and checking, raw-product parity reconstruction, field high-three-bit terms, reduction, inversion, and full-walk work are outside the timed kernel.
The 0.05ms floor excludes very short events but does not guarantee low timing variance. All sample distributions must be retained and interpreted.
